protocol: Source paper section 3.3: FULL mean, ILM-OPL max, OPL-BM max. Layer intervals closed; native center z=(z256+0.5)*640/256-0.5; MATLAB boundaries minus 1; projection orientation XY. Raw [0,1] projections used for scores. GT layer annotations used only for post-hoc evaluation, not generation. Official BMP is a display reference, not the target for raw projection metrics. Native reconstructed OPL-BM is not pixel-identical to official BMP.
